title: One tool or two locations?
hook: Which layout removes the shown shuttle trips?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that working at two stations with one tool adds a carry every time you switch, which a second tool removes at the cost of storing two

misconception: Sharing one tool between two work spots is fine because it is only carried a short way.
objective: The example alternates between two stations. A tool at each avoids carrying one back and forth, while increasing the number of tools stored; the stage makes that trade-off explicit.
